environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a VPC with a standard NAT gateway for outbound traffic. The container runs on Fargate platform version 1.4.0 with awsvpc networking mode. The service is exposed via an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 8080. No request rate limiting is configured. The S3 bucket 'prod-api-keys-config' is accessed over the public S3 endpoint via the NAT gateway. Task IAM role has s3:GetObject permission on the config bucket. No VPC endpoint for S3 is configured.

config.s3_access: Via NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint
